description: Notra is a GEO and AI-content platform that tracks brand visibility in AI engines, attributes AI agent traffic, identifies content gaps, and helps teams generate posts and changelogs in a saved brand voice.
summary: Notra exposes a bearer-authenticated HTTP API at api.usenotra.com, a hosted OAuth/API-key MCP server at mcp.usenotra.com/mcp, and an npm-distributed `notra` CLI for the same workspace operations.
